title: Kissed Crispy Canadian Cod Skewers
description: A charred and crispy Canadian dish featuring cod, hot chilli powder, and a nostalgic touch, cooked to perfection using sous-vide and finished with a crispy exterior. This pescatarian-friendly recipe is sure to delight.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together hot chilli powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the cod cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Thread the coated cod cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in a single layer in a sous-vide bag and drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Seal the bag and cook in the sous-vide machine for 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to high heat.
Remove the skewers from the sous-vide bag and grill for 2-3 minutes per side, or until charred and crispy.
Serve the kissed crispy Canadian cod skewers hot, garnished with lemon wedges and parsley.
